results.original_text: As a site editor, I want to have pretty good control over how the article, so that articles are visually appealing.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the design and layout of articles so that the content is visually appealing and engages readers effectively.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editing interface must provide at least 10 customizable design elements (e.g., fonts, colors, images) to enhance the visual presentation of articles.
- Editors should be able to preview changes in real-time, with updates reflecting within 1 second after adjustments are made, achieving a satisfaction rate of ≥85% among editors for usability.
- Articles should maintain a consistent visual style across all devices, ensuring a responsive design that passes cross-device compatibility tests with a success rate of ≥95%.

Test Outline:
- Review the range of customizable design options available in the editing interface and verify their functionality.
- Conduct testing to measure the real-time update speed and gather editor feedback on the usability of the preview feature.
- Perform compatibility testing on various devices to ensure consistent visual styling across platforms.

User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that I can create visually appealing content that engages readers effectively.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editing interface should allow for at least 10 customizable design elements (e.g., fonts, colors, images) to enhance article presentation.
- Changes made to the article's layout must be previewed in real-time, with a loading time of ≤ 1 second for the preview to ensure a smooth editing experience.
- At least 85% of articles published should meet the visual appeal standards as rated by user feedback surveys.

Test Outline:
- Review the editing interface to verify the availability of customizable design options and test the real-time preview functionality.
- Conduct user surveys post-publication to gather ratings on the visual appeal of the articles and analyze the results.

User Story:
As a site editor, I want to have comprehensive control over the article formatting and layout so that the articles are visually appealing and enhance reader engagement.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The editor should be able to customize text styles (font size, color, and spacing) with at least 5 different formatting options available for each element.
- Layout adjustments must be applied seamlessly, allowing for changes to be previewed in real-time with a response time of ≤ 1 second.
- User engagement metrics, such as time spent on page and bounce rate, should show a ≥15% improvement after implementing enhanced visual controls.

Test Outline:
- Assess the number of formatting options available and verify the ease of use through hands-on testing.
- Monitor the real-time preview functionality to ensure it meets the performance benchmark.
- Analyze user engagement metrics before and after implementing the new formatting controls to measure the impact.

results.original_text: I want a search bar on the top of the page.
results.final_text:
User Story:
As a website user, I want a search bar prominently located at the top of the page so that I can quickly initiate searches for content or products without scrolling or navigating away from the current view.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be accessible on the top of the page for 100% of users and visible across all device types (desktop, tablet, mobile).
- Users should be able to initiate a search within 1 click and receive results in under 2 seconds, achieving a satisfaction rate of ≥85% regarding ease of use.
- The search functionality should support at least 3 advanced filtering options to refine results effectively, with 70% of users utilizing these filters.

Test Outline:
- Verify the search bar's visibility and accessibility on various devices and screen sizes.
- Track the time taken to receive search results and conduct user surveys to gauge satisfaction levels.
- Analyze the usage statistics of the advanced filtering options to assess their effectiveness.

history.text:
User Story:
As a website visitor, I want to have a search bar prominently located at the top of the page so that I can easily find content or products without excessive scrolling or navigation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The search bar must be accessible on the top of the page for 100% of users visiting the site.
- It should allow users to submit queries within 1 second of typing, achieving a responsiveness rate of ≥95%.
- The implementation of the search bar should result in a 20% increase in user engagement metrics, such as time spent on site and number of pages visited.

Test Outline:
- Verify the placement and visibility of the search bar across different devices and screen sizes.
- Measure the response time from the moment the user begins typing to when results are generated.
- Analyze user engagement data before and after the implementation to confirm the expected increase.
